query:
INSERT INTO chats (telegram_id, type, title, username, created_at, updated_at)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now(), now())
        ON CONFLICT (telegram_id) DO UPDATE SET
            type = EXCLUDED.type,
            title = EXCLUDED.title,
            username = EXCLUDED.username,
            updated_at = now()
        RETURNING id;
